description: This Java class defines a tasklet used in a batch job for adding accrual transactions for savings accounts. It implements the Spring Batch Tasklet interface and coordinates with a service to perform accrual entries up to the current business date.

classes.name: AddAccrualTransactionForSavingsTasklet
classes.description: Implements a batch tasklet for adding accrual transactions to savings accounts, utilizing the Fineract framework and Spring Batch infrastructure.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point for the batch step. Calls addPeriodicAccruals with the current business date and handles exceptions.

methods.name: addPeriodicAccruals
methods.description: Invokes the savings accrual service to add accrual entries up to 'tilldate'.
